title: scilla peruviana var. venusta
intro: Scilla peruviana var. venusta, commonly known as the lesser squill, is a flowering plant in the Asparagaceae family. It is known for its bulbous underground stems, which produce blue-violet flowers in the spring. The plant has been used in traditional medicine, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Scilla peruviana var. venusta include alkaloids, saponins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
